items.item: (1) C by F9 in records' current fields
items.how: 125 field edits in 48 records, plus one Chinese alignment in what-would-give-c. Each was scripted as an exact substring asserted once per field, and each record was re-dumped in its own format (indent 2), so a diff shows only the changed lines. (a) 21 does-not-show lines said 'a ranking (of courses) rests on C or another named order' or 'a ranking holds the comparison C or another order'. They now say 'a result that ranks courses states the order its theorem takes', which is 07 T8's own sentence (zh 排序（进程）之果，陈述其定理所取之次序). The records are capture-by-counted-choices, comparing-two-courses, confined-rise, drawn-shaping, fixation-with-selection, groups-formed-by-descent, loss-read-in-time, mutation-and-the-balance, pace-of-selection, the three selection records, the three shaping records, tasks-and-what-performs-them, the-breeding-value, unequal-groups, what-a-course-keeps-reachable, what-a-set-point-optimum and where-the-possible-grows. (b) 'ranking by widening is C, a named order' or 'C's' (a-narrowing-above-its-widening, widening-as-what-every-positive-weighting-ranks, keeping-widening-is-generation-losing-nothing) now reads 'widening is more future, not a good, and a result ranking by it takes that order (C) as a hypothesis'. (c) Scope-and-order role lines no longer give C an order role. These are alignment-approaches (statement: widening is what every order counting everything shares on a listing, law 3, with no C; hypotheses[2] names the class of orders; does_not_show[1], related[9], next_delta), alignment-direction-under-widening (hypotheses[0] 'C read as widening, a hypothesis'; overview without 'read under scope and order' and 'for scope / for order'), organizational-formation hypotheses[0], premises-met-and-failed related[0], wisdom-root hypotheses[1], the-continuation-condition-on-the-root does_not_show[3], what-the-step-across-standpoints-reaches does_not_show[2], when-holding / when-no-route does_not_show[2], where-two-courses-rejoin hypotheses[1] and next_delta, self-concern-through-dependence does_not_show[5], what-the-dynamics-leave-open does_not_show[2], continuation-condition-yields-living-significance hypotheses[2] (now 'C (`Comparison`) is a hypothesis where a theorem takes it'), and one-root-to-its-edge (statement, standings[41], both premise items). (d) Exact theorem wording. what-self-concern-alone-ranks laws[0] 'self-concern's monotonicity is C's premise' became 'there self-concern is being increasing in admission' (`increasingInOwn_iff_increasing`). Its does_not_show[0] now reads 'a hypothesis, asking less of an order than C does'. what-would-give-c laws[1] now reads 'one property of an order in two forms, self-concern and C'. weights-within-a-ratio now says 'widening ranks neither side of a mixed pair above the other'. what-can-be-born-next uses law 16's 'no course from the empty set widens another'. eventual-widening calls C∞ 'an order beyond C'. Two related details for comparing-two-courses and what-a-course-keeps-reachable no longer say 'C read as widening ... adopted by C'. C is kept wherever a theorem takes `Comparison`: becoming-spine-instances, relational-reading-comparison, alignment-direction's progress and interface, premises-met-and-failed laws[4]'s ListedPaths witnesses, and what-would-give-c's laws.

F5. one-root-to-its-edge's scope basis 'No should stands beyond becoming, so there is no warrant binding every mind to find ... does not wait on one' now reads: 'and a perspectivist denies it without contradiction. The ethics seeks no authority outside becoming (argued, on the thesis of one relational unfolding); whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind is not claimed or settled'. positioned-positive-reason and practical-judgment-under-living-significance related[0] said 'answered within the map, argued (there is none to find)'. They now say 'set aside as one the map does not need', and the first adds the same not-claimed clause. Chinese: 作为地图所不需要的问题而搁置, the warrant record's wording. F4. The edge record's order basis, what-would-give-c related[0] and the-continuation-condition-on-the-root does_not_show[3] said 'listed level paths' and 'ranks listed level paths as C does'. They now say 'between two level paths whose admissions fit in a finite list, one way' and 'courses that end' where the basis states the theorem. F1. The edge record now says 'an order holding one's own continuation (self-concern, in the proofs a hypothesis derived from no dynamics)' and no longer says 'holding one's own continuation ranks'. F2, F3 and F6. Scans found no record equating the condition with 续无外 without the reading or the de se clause, no 'not yet joined' of the mutual-dependence step, and no 'a matter of reach'. continuation-condition-yields-living-significance does_not_show[7] drops '(chapter 7 says how order emerges with it)', which said more than is there.

'No should stands beyond becoming, so there is no warrant binding every possible mind to find (chapter 7, argued)' became 'The ethics seeks no authority outside becoming (argued, on the thesis of one relational unfolding); whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind is not claimed or settled (chapter 7)'. The Chinese is 伦理不在生灭变化之外寻求权威（属论证，依一个关系展开之论题）；在生灭变化之中形成的理由能否对一切心智成立，本论既不主张也不裁定（第 7 章）. Edited as raw substrings, so the file keeps its own format. Incident: my first attempt opened the file for writing before computing the output, the dump raised, and the file was left empty. Git status at the session's start did not list it as modified, so I restored it byte for byte from HEAD (5,870 bytes) before applying the edit. Every later write computed its output before opening the file.

Eleven open items quoted changed does-not-show lines word for word. Each now carries its record's new line. They are a-course-that-only-returns[1], a-pair-tolerates[0], confined-rise[3], errors-by-chance[0], habit-lock-in-active-inference[3], mutation-and-the-balance[2], rule-raised-every-other-step[2], selection-among-groups-by-ending[2], what-a-set-point-optimum[7], what-decides-giving[0] and where-the-possible-grows[6]. Two mechanisms (selection-among-groups-by-ending and rule-raised-every-other-step) and what-an-optimum-does-beyond-what-couples-in open[10] said 'rests on C or another named order' and now say 'a result ... states the order its theorem takes'. A scan found no other frame phrase in the file. Its remaining 'warrant' words are other senses: certificates and warranted limits.
